_comment: Round unlock scope. Source of truth: cisco-module-map.md section 2. Scope is CUMULATIVE: once a module unlocks it stays in scope, which is why State includes 21-22 even though its own row reads 1-17. Set `date` to an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the season posts and the countdown activates.

practice.name: Practice Round
practice.note: Tool literacy round. The networking is easy; the points are lost to Packet Tracer itself.

r1.name: Round 1
r1.note: The quiz is drawn from Modules 3–7 only, and it is heavily terminology. U2 is this round.

r2.name: Round 2
r2.note: Modules 21–22 unlock here, AHEAD of 12–17. Teaching in numeric order leaves you unprepared for this round. That is why U4 exists.

state.name: State Round
state.note: Adds 12–17. Packet Tracer stops being a diagramming tool and becomes a troubleshooting environment. This round is won on Strand E.

semis.name: Semifinals
semis.note: Subnetting (Modules 20 + 23) is the single highest-value skill in this round.
